name: John Doe
summary: Software developer with 3 years' professional experience building web platforms, automation tools and AI integrations in C#/.NET, Python and JavaScript on Azure. Sole developer of a client-facing Blazor platform, owning architecture, API design, testing, CI/CD, containerised deployment and documentation. Background in architecture and BIM, with a track record of turning client requirements into software that cuts months of manual work down to weeks.

architect.summary: Architectural designer with Part 1 and Part 2/3 experience at Falconer Chester Hall Architects and an M.Arch from the Computational Architecture atelier at Manchester School of Architecture. Assisted with, and at times managed, a 700-unit residential project, and provided BIM support and tooling to the whole office. Builds Dynamo scripts, Revit add-ins and real-time visualisations that make design and documentation workflows faster.
